scripts.text:
[Noyee]
Did you know that there's a difference between the armor you can buy from NPC shops and the kinds you obtain from hunting monsters?
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
你知道嗎？從NPC商店購買的防具，和通過狩獵魔物獲得的防具，其實是有區別的。

scripts.text:
[Noyee]
The difference, my friend, is in the number of ^3355FFslots^000000 in your armor.
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
朋友，區別就在於防具上的^3355FF插槽^000000數量。

scripts.text:
[Noyee]
The same kind of Armor will have the same Defense. However, if an Armor has a slot, you can insert a Monster Card which will add an enhancement to that armor.
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
同一種防具的防禦力是相同的。但是，如果防具上有插槽，你可以插入魔物卡片，從而為防具增加額外的強化效果。

scripts.text:
[Noyee]
Both Monster Cards and Slotted Armors are rarely dropped by monsters, and are thus valuable commodies.
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
魔物卡片和帶插槽的防具都很少從魔物身上掉落，因此是非常珍貴的商品。

scripts.text:
[Noyee]
You know, there's a very interesting place that looks
sort of like a laboratory in Juno.
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
你知道嗎，在朱諾有一個非常有趣的地方，看起來有點像實驗室。

scripts.text:
[Noyee]
Anyway, no one is really sure if it is or not. Recently, it's been the focus of many rumors. I have no idea if any of them are true though.
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
總之，沒人能確定它到底是不是實驗室。最近，它成了許多傳聞的焦點。不過，我也不知道這些傳聞裡有沒有真的。

scripts.text: ^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF等一下！您現在攜帶的物品太多了。請先將部分物品存入卡普拉倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
I can't believe how busy I am at work nowadays. I don't even have time to see any of my friends or go shopping.
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
真不敢相信我現在工作有多忙。我甚至沒有時間去見朋友或逛街。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Wait...!
I can't even remember the last
time I went out with a guy! At this rate, I might retire before I can find a boyfriend. Noooo, I'm still in my prime~!
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
等等...！
我甚至不記得上次和男人約會是什麼時候了！照這樣下去，我可能在找到男朋友之前就退休了。不不不，我還正值青春呢~！

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
We conduct research on godly artifacts that were left behind by the gods long ago. More specifically, we're interested in the tools the gods used.
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
我們在研究很久以前神明留下的神聖神器。更具體地說，我們關注的是神明使用過的工具。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Recently, many of the members of our research group, aside from the leaders, have left so now we're short on manpower.
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
最近，除了首領之外，我們研究小組的許多成員都離開了，所以現在人手不足。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Since we're understaffed, we can't continue most of our research projects that are currently in progress. Speaking of which...
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
由於人手不足，我們無法繼續目前正在進行的大多數研究專案。說到這個...

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Do you mind if I ask
an adventurer like yourself
to help us in our research?
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
能請像你這樣的冒險者幫助我們進行研究嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
We won't experiment on you or anything, we just need you to run some simple errands. And of course, you will be rewarded.
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
我們不會拿你做實驗什麼的，只需要你跑一些簡單的腿。當然，你會得到報酬的。

scripts.text: I'm kind of busy...
scripts.translation: 我有點忙...

scripts.text: Sure, why not?
scripts.translation: 當然，為什麼不呢？

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Oh, I see.
Well, if you happen to find anyone that might work well as a temporary research assistant, would you recommend them to us?
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
哦，我明白了。
那麼，如果你恰好發現有人可能很適合做臨時研究助手，你會推薦給我們嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
I'm so sorry to ask this of you, but I hope you understand that we're seriously lacking in terms
of human resources.
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
很抱歉提出這個要求，但我希望你能理解，我們在人力資源方面確實非常匱乏。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Really~?!
That's great!
Hahahahaha! I'm so
glad to hear that!
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
真的~？！
太好了！
哈哈哈哈哈！聽到這個我太高興了！

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Go inside and speak to the investigators there. They're all kind of swamped, so I'm sure they'll need your assistance.
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
進去和那裡的調查員們對話吧。他們都很忙，我相信他們一定需要你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Oh, wait...
Let me give you a temporary admission pass. Thank you
so much for your help~
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
哦，等等...
讓我給你一張臨時通行證。非常感謝你的幫助~

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've received
a temporary
admission pass.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你獲得了一張臨時通行證。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
It's really difficult to managing a laboratory. Rival labs always try to entice our staff away or interrupt our progress.
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
管理實驗室真的很難。競爭對手總是試圖挖走我們的職員，或者干擾我們的研究進度。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
And because of this job, it's really hard for me to enjoy
having a personal life...
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
而且因為這份工作，我很難享受個人生活...

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Hahahaha...
What am I doing?
Please just ignore what I just said. It's really not that big of a deal. ^333333*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
哈哈哈哈哈...
我在說什麼呢？
請忽略我剛才說的話。這真的沒什麼大不了的。^333333*嘆氣...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Ah, thank you
for helping us out.
I hope you'll continue
to lend us your assistance.
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
啊，謝謝你幫助我們。
希望你能繼續支援我們。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Although our researchers are kind of strange, they're all pretty nice and they mean well.
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
雖然我們的研究員有點古怪，但他們都很友善，而且心地善良。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
So I hope you understand if a few of them treat you in a way that seems kind of rude.
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
所以如果其中幾個人對待你的方式顯得有些無禮，希望你能理解。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Ah...
You really helped us out a lot. Thank you for all you have done.
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
啊...
你真的幫了我們大忙。謝謝你所做的一切。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
As you already know, we're trying to find out whether or not we can reproduce 'Sleipnir,' one of the tools used by the gods.
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
如你所知，我們正在研究是否能夠重現“史雷普尼爾”，那是眾神使用的神器之一。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
However....
So far it seems impossible, at least with the technology that we currently have. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
然而....
目前看來這似乎是不可能的，至少以我們現有的技術來說。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Anyways, we will continue to research and hope that we'll be able to accomplish our goal of recreating Sleipnir someday.
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
總之，我們將繼續研究，希望有一天能實現重現史雷普尼爾的目標。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Thanks to you, we were able to complete a rudimentary study of Sleipnir. Now we can plan out a more advanced study of Sleipnir.
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
多虧了你，我們完成了對史雷普尼爾的初步研究。現在我們可以規劃更高階的研究了。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Before I forget, let me give you your reward for assisting in our research projects. Please give
me a minute...
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
在我忘記之前，讓我給你獎勵，以表彰你對我們研究專案的協助。請給我一分鐘...

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Ah, there it is.
It might not be much, but I hope you accept it as a token of my gratitude. Good luck on your travels!
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
啊，在這裡。
這可能不算什麼，但我希望你能收下它作為我的一點心意。祝你旅途順利！

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Ah, I'll also need to take back that temporary pass I gave to you. I'm sorry, but it's protocol we have to follow...
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
啊，我還需要收回之前給你的臨時通行證。很抱歉，這是我們必須遵守的規定...

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Once again,
thank you for
all your help~
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
再次感謝你的所有幫助~

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
With your assistance, we successfully completed our rudimentary study.
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
在你的協助下，我們成功完成了初步研究。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
From now on, we'll plan out our more advanced studies based on the information we now have on the godly artifacts.
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
從現在開始，我們將根據目前掌握的神器資訊，規劃更高階的研究。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Now that things
have slowed down
a little...
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
現在事情稍微輕鬆了一點...

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
I can finally
go on a date!
Hahahahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
我終於可以去約會了！
哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
I can't believe how busy I am at work nowadays. I don't even have time to see any of my friends or go shopping.
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
真不敢相信我現在工作有多忙。我甚至沒有時間去見朋友或逛街。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Wait...!
I can't even remember the last
time I went out with a guy! At this rate, I might retire before I can find a boyfriend. Noooo, I'm still in my prime~!
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
等等...！
我甚至不記得上次和男人約會是什麼時候了！照這樣下去，我可能在找到男朋友之前就退休了。不不不，我還正值青春呢~！

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Ah, you've come back.
I know you were going to help us, but someone already applied for the assistant position.
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
啊，你回來了。
我知道你本來打算幫助我們，但已經有人申請了助手的職位。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Anyway, we've already finished our current research projects. Now, we're in the planning stages for the next projects we'll be conducting...
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
總之，我們已經完成了目前的研究專案。現在，我們正在規劃下一階段的研究...

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Thank you anyway, though. I hope you will come and help us the next time we need assistance on our projects.
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
不過還是要謝謝你。希望下次我們需要協助時，你能再來幫助我們。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Now that we've completed our rudimentary studies, we'll simply plan out our future research projects.
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
既然我們已經完成了基礎研究，接下來就只需規劃未來的研究專案了。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Now that things
have slowed down
a little...
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
現在事情稍微輕鬆了一點...

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
I can finally
go on a date!
Hahahahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[庫庫雷]
我終於可以去約會了！
哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Ah, are you the one whom Ms. Kirin referred? Yes, she said you were going to help me in my research.
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
啊，你是麒麟小姐介紹來的那位嗎？是的，她說你會來協助我的研究。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Frankly, we don't really need anyone who doesn't specialize
in our field of study.
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
老實說，我們並不需要非本領域專家的人手。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
But if you don't mind helping us out by doing little, menial tasks, then it'd probably bring some relief to our workload.
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
但如果你不介意幫忙做一些瑣碎的雜務，那應該能稍微減輕我們的工作量。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Now...
What would be
a good job for you?
Let me think...
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
那麼...
什麼工作適合你呢？
讓我想想...

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
I got it!
Why don't you go and visit ^FF0000Metto^000000 for me? Please bring me any news that he'd like to report.
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
我想到了！
你能替我去拜訪一下^FF0000梅托^000000嗎？請帶回來他想要彙報的任何訊息。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Since he's working on a project similar to mine, he might be in a position to help me. Metto lives in Juno, so you can easily find me.
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
因為他正在做和我類似的專案，也許他能幫上忙。梅托住在朱諾，你應該很容易找到他。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
I guess you haven't found Metto yet. Although he might be a little over enthusiastic at times, he's not a bad guy at all.
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
看來你還沒找到梅托。雖然他有時候有點過於熱情，但他其實是個不錯的人。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
We've been friends for a long time after working in the same field for so long. I wonder how he's doing?
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
我們在同一領域工作很久了，所以已經是老朋友了。不知道他現在過得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Anyway, just ask him about any progress on his research. And if he happens to ask you for help, please lend him your assistance.
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
總之，問問他研究的進展吧。如果他恰好需要幫助，請儘量協助他。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Hmmm...
So how's Metto?
Hmm? It seems like
he has changed...
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
嗯...
梅托怎麼樣了？
嗯？看來他變了...

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Hmmm...
So how's Metto?
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
嗯...
梅托怎麼樣了？

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
A mad scientist?
That doesn't sound right. In my wildest dreams, I never would have suspected Metto of turning out that way...
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
瘋狂科學家？
這聽起來不對勁。我做夢都沒想到梅托會變成那樣...

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Huh. That's...
That's too bad. I don't know what to say. We used to go watch movies and celebrate our birthdays together. P-please give me a moment...
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
啊...這...
太遺憾了。我不知道該說什麼。我們以前會一起看電影，一起慶祝生日。請...請給我一點時間...

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Ah...
You came back.
Alright, let me give you the gist of what I'm researching.
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
啊...
你回來了。
好吧，讓我給你講講我正在研究的內容。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
I'm trying to learn more about the '^FF0000Wheel of the Unknown^000000,' which was discovered to be a piece of the artifact known as ^FF0000Sleipnir^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
我正在深入研究'^FF0000未知的鋸齒輪子^000000'，它被發現是神器^FF0000史雷普尼爾^000000的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
It looks like
a normal cogwheel...
But I can't figure out how it's supposed to work.
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
它看起來像普通的齒輪...
但我搞不清楚它是怎麼運作的。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
The most peculiar thing of all about this cogwheel is the metal
of which it is composed.
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
這個齒輪最特別的地方，在於構成它的金屬材質。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
It looks and feels like steel,but extreme heat and cold don't affect it. It also cannot be dented by any kind of impact or force I can apply to it.
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
它看起來和摸起來都像鋼鐵，但極度的高溫和嚴寒對它都沒有影響。而且，無論我施加什麼樣的衝擊力或力量，都無法在它上面留下任何凹痕。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Sometimes, I find that the Wheel of the Unknown resonates with certain objects, but I haven't got it to occur all of the time.
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
有時候，我發現“未知的鋸齒輪子”會與某些物品產生共鳴，但我還沒能讓它每次都發生。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
I'm guessing that I'm missing some sort of special condition that will make the Wheel of the Unknown resonate with specific materials.
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
我猜測，我可能遺漏了某種特殊條件，能讓“未知的鋸齒輪子”與特定材質產生共鳴。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Anyway, I thank you for helping me out earlier. That's basically all I needed, so please talk to the other researchers and see if they need any assistance.
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
總之，非常感謝你之前的幫助。我基本上已經得到我需要的資訊了，所以請去和其他研究員談談，看看他們是否需要協助。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Oh, sorry.
I'm quite busy compiling all of this information at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
哦，抱歉。
我現在正忙著整理所有的資料。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Let's see...
Now how would I...
^333333*Mumble mumble*^000000
scripts.translation:
[哈蘭道特]
讓我看看...
那麼我該怎麼做呢...
^333333*咕噥咕噥*^000000

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

你帶來的材料應該足夠我進行實驗了。非常感謝。

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

such a great help.

scripts.translation:

Hmmm....
Funds and
manpower are
important for
research to progress.
scripts.translation:

嗯...
資金和人力對於研究的推進至關重要。

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
But no amount of financing or staffing can replace the value of enthusiasm and passion in conducting research.
scripts.translation:
[庫爾特]
但無論多少資金或人員，都無法取代在研究過程中熱情與激情的價值。

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
Some financiers are so ignorant that they think that if they throw more money and people into a project, the secrets of science will be unlocked that much faster.
scripts.translation:
[庫爾特]
有些資助者非常無知，他們認為只要往專案裡投入更多的錢和人，就能更快地揭開科學的秘密。

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
But if the people doing your research are unmotivated and uninspired, you'll never get anywhere.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Lania]
No matter how old the stories are, you can always find good advice in folk tales and legends.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
無論故事多麼古老，你總能從民間傳說和傳奇中找到有益的建議。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Despite the passing of time and mankind's progression, certain fundamentals of life are timeless and will never change.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
儘管時光流逝，人類不斷進步，但某些生活的基本準則是永恆的，永遠不會改變。

scripts.text: Umm...
I see.
scripts.translation: 我明白了

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Hmm...?
Do you need
anything from me?
I will try to help
you as much as I can.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
嗯...？
你需要我幫忙嗎？
我會盡力幫助你的。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
I believe that it's no use having ability or power unless you use that power for the right purposes.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
我相信，如果不用能力或力量去做正確的事，那麼擁有它們就沒有意義。

scripts.text: Oh no, that's okay.
scripts.translation: 不，不用了

scripts.text: Sleipnir's story.
scripts.translation: 史雷普尼爾的故事

scripts.text:
[Lania]
I must have
misunderstood me.
However, feel free
to ask me for help
if you ever need it.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
看來是我誤會了。
不過，如果你需要幫助，隨時可以找我。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
I consider helping others as special training for my spiritual improvement. I hope that you will act with kindness and generosity towards others as well.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
我認為幫助他人是提升精神境界的一種特殊修行。希望你在對待他人時也能保持善良和慷慨。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Ah, I see.
I can tell you what I know about Sleipnir. Let's see now if I can remember everything about it.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
啊，我明白了。
我可以告訴你我所知道的關於史雷普尼爾的事。讓我想想，看能不能回憶起所有細節。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Ah yes.
I remember it now.
Yes, Sleipnir was the
name of Odin's stallion.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
啊，是的。
我想起來了。
是的，史雷普尼爾是奧丁的坐騎。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
In the world of
gods, there were
three legendary stallions: Sleipnir, Svadilfari and Gullfaxi.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
在神界，有三匹傳奇的駿馬：史雷普尼爾、斯瓦迪爾法裡和古爾法克西。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Gullfaxi was owned by Hrungnir, the king of the giants. Svadilfari, the stallion that sired Sleipnir, was also owned by a giant.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
古爾法克西屬於巨人王赫魯格尼爾。而史雷普尼爾的父親斯瓦迪爾法裡，也屬於一位巨人。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Okay, now let's talk about how 'Sleipnir' was born. This story gives us a glimpse of the fallibility of gods and giants.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
好了，現在讓我們談談“史雷普尼爾”的誕生。這個故事讓我們得以窺見神與巨人的侷限性。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
In Asgard, the realm of the gods, there was a huge protective rampart that was almost completely destroyed in a recent war.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
在神域阿斯加德，有一道巨大的防禦城牆，在最近的戰爭中被幾乎完全摧毀了。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
However...
Gods being gods,
they were not eager
to rebuild the walls
themselves.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
然而...
神畢竟是神，他們並不急於親自重建城牆。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
One day, a very
skinny man rode on
a dark horse and offered to rebuild, and even improve, the rampart protecting Asgard.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
有一天，一個非常瘦弱的男人騎著一匹黑馬出現，提出願意重建甚至改進保護阿斯加德的城牆。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
His offer was tempting to the gods, who needed every protection from their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
他的提議對神們來說很有吸引力，因為他們需要一切保護來抵禦敵人。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
This man promised to rebuild
the Asgardian rampart in only 18 months, but in return he wanted the goddess Freya as his wife, as well as ownership of the sun and the moon.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
這個男人承諾在18個月內重建阿斯加德的城牆，但作為回報，他要求娶女神芙蕾雅為妻，並擁有太陽和月亮。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Now, this price was unreasonable for the gods to pay. The Asgardians were all insulted and angered by the stranger's demands. Still, they did want their rampart to be rebuilt.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
這個條件對眾神來說太過分了。阿斯加德的神靈們都被這個陌生人的要求激怒和羞辱了。不過，他們確實希望城牆能被重建。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
.....
Are you bored?
If you are, we can
finish this
story later.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
.....
你無聊了嗎？
如果是的話，我們可以稍後再講完這個故事。

scripts.text: Yeah, let's finish this later.
scripts.translation: 是的，稍後再講吧

scripts.text: No, please go ahead.
scripts.translation: 不，請繼續

scripts.text:
[Lania]
I understand that my story was not that interesting. But I will try my best to entertain you next time. Please travel in safety.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
我理解我的故事可能沒那麼有趣。但下次我會盡力讓你覺得有趣。請一路平安。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Oh alright.
Then let me continue.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
哦，好的。
那我繼續講。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
The gods were furious with the stranger's ridiculous demands. However, Loki proposed to Odin
that they should let the stranger rebuild their defensive walls.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
眾神對這個陌生人的無理要求感到憤怒。然而，洛基向奧丁提議，讓他們允許這個陌生人重建防禦城牆。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Loki suggested that if the stranger could complete most of the rampart renovation, but later than as agreed, the gods would not be obligated to pay the stranger any price.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
洛基建議，如果這個陌生人能完成大部分城牆的修繕，但晚於約定的時間，眾神就沒有義務支付任何報酬。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Odin decided to follow Loki's advice, and told the stranger that the wall must be repaired in 6 months, instead of 18 months as the stranger had proposed. He could receive help from no man.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
奧丁決定採納洛基的建議，並告訴陌生人，城牆必須在6個月內修好，而不是他提議的18個月。他不能得到任何人的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
In return, the stranger would be paid as he had asked if he could fulfill those conditions. Since he was just a man, it seemed impossible.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
作為回報，如果他滿足這些條件，就會得到他要求的報酬。既然他只是一個凡人，這似乎是不可能的。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Hmmm...
I know this story is quite long. Did you want to listen some more, or did you need a break?
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
嗯...
我知道這個故事挺長的。你想繼續聽，還是需要休息一下？

scripts.text: Let me take down some notes first.
scripts.translation: 讓我先記點筆記

scripts.text: I need a break!
scripts.translation: 我需要休息一下！

scripts.text: No, please go ahead.
scripts.translation: 不，請繼續

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Ah....
I understand this story is quite long. My apologies. Alright, I'll wait for you to finish writing your notes.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
啊....
我理解這個故事挺長的。抱歉。好的，我會等你寫完筆記。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
May I continue the story now?
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
我可以繼續講故事了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，請

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Okay, now
where was I?
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
好的，我剛才講到哪了？

scripts.text:
[Lania]
I understand that the tale of Sleipnir is pretty long. But if you have the patience, I will try to relate this story to you another time. Farewell~
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
我理解史雷普尼爾的故事挺長的。但如果你有耐心，我會試著在下次再給你講這個故事。再見~

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Oh good.
Then please let me continue.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
哦，太好了。
那請讓我繼續。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Now, the stranger insisted that he be able to use his horse to help him do this reconstruction work. Since the horse was rather plain and simple looking, Odin agreed.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
接著，那個陌生人堅持要用他的馬來幫助完成這項重建工作。因為這匹馬看起來相當普通，奧丁便答應了。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Odin didn't think
twice about his
request, and regretted this decision upon observing the stranger's first day of rebuilding the rampart.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
奧丁沒有多想就答應了他的請求，直到看到陌生人重建城牆的第一天，他才後悔了這個決定。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Strangely enough, the stranger, using his horse to carry the materials, rebuilt the rampart at a speed that was inhuman.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
奇怪的是，陌生人用馬馱著材料，以非人的速度重建了城牆。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
This upset the gods, since the stranger was actually a mighty giant in disguise. However, this did not violate their agreement,
so the gods could do nothing.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
這讓眾神感到不安，因為那個陌生人實際上是一個偽裝起來的強大巨人。然而，這並沒有違反他們的約定，所以眾神無能為力。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Although the stranger's skills were great, his horse greatly sped up the rampart reconstruction. This was the legendary magical horse, Svadilfari.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
雖然陌生人的技藝高超，但他的馬極大地加快了城牆的重建速度。這匹傳奇的魔法馬名叫斯瓦迪爾法裡。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
The gods grew more anxious as the wall would soon be completed before the alloted six months were up. The Asgardians soon grew very angry with Loki.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
隨著城牆即將在規定的六個月期限前完工，眾神變得越來越焦慮。阿斯加德人很快就對洛基感到非常憤怒。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Despite this, Loki remained calm and assured the gods that he had a plan. The gods distrusted his craftiness, and grew desperate as the stranger's work speedily progressed.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
儘管如此，洛基依然保持冷靜，並保證眾神他有計劃。眾神不信任他的狡猾，隨著陌生人的工作迅速推進，他們變得絕望起來。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Then, the reconstruction of the rampart suddenly halted. Both the gods and the stranger were equally surprised, as the horse Svadilfari was now missing.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
然後，城牆的重建突然停止了。眾神和陌生人都同樣驚訝，因為馬斯瓦迪爾法裡不見了。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
The stranger would
now need to continue
his work by himself.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
現在，陌生人只能獨自繼續他的工作了。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Hmmm...
Are you still listening? If you're tired, I understand and we can
stop for now.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
嗯...
你還在聽嗎？如果你累了，我理解，我們可以先停一下。

scripts.text: I'm so exhausted!
scripts.translation: 我太累了！

scripts.text: No, please go ahead.
scripts.translation: 不，請繼續

scripts.text:
[Lania]
I know that this story might seem too long. But if you ever want to sit down and hear it again, I'll be glad to go over it again. Thank you for listening, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
我知道這個故事可能顯得太長了。但如果你以後想坐下來再聽一遍，我很樂意再講一次。謝謝你聽我講，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Oh alright,
I'll go on then.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
哦，好的，那我繼續了。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
In their curiosity, the gods decided to investigate Savdilfari's disappearance.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
出於好奇，眾神決定調查斯瓦迪爾法裡失蹤的原因。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Surprisingly,
they found that
Svadilfari fell in love with a beautiful mare, which was why
it did not work on the rampart.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
令人驚訝的是，他們發現斯瓦迪爾法裡愛上了一匹美麗的母馬，這就是它沒有繼續修建城牆的原因。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
So when the 6 months passed, the stranger almost finished rebuilding the Asgardian walls. Only the castle gate was left untouched.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
所以，當六個月期限過去時，陌生人幾乎完成了阿斯加德城牆的重建。只剩下城堡大門還沒有動工。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
The gods were happy to tell the stranger that they could not pay him what he requested, since he did not complete the rampart as originally agreed.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
眾神很高興地告訴陌生人，由於他沒有按照最初的約定完成城牆，所以他們無法支付他要求的報酬。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
In his rage, the stranger accused the gods of tricking him so that they would not have to pay him with the sun, the moon and the beautiful goddess Freya. Then, he revealed his true identity.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
在憤怒中，陌生人指責眾神欺騙他，以便他們不用支付太陽、月亮和美麗的女神芙蕾雅作為報酬。然後，他揭示了自己的真實身份。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
He was a
terrible frost giant,
or Hrimthurs as they say.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
他是一個可怕的霜巨人，也就是他們所說的赫裡姆瑟斯。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
.....
Are you bored?
If you are, we can
talk about this
later you know.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
.....
你無聊了嗎？
如果是的話，我們可以以後再聊，你知道嗎。

scripts.text: I'm so bored~
scripts.translation: 我有點無聊~

scripts.text: No, please go ahead.
scripts.translation: 不，請繼續

scripts.text:
[Lania]
I see. Well, stories are meant to be enjoyed and I suppose you're not in the mood to sit and listen.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
我明白了。故事本來就是用來享受的，看來你現在沒有心情坐下來聽。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
But if you ever do want to hear about Sleipnir, feel free to visit me once again. Have a good day~
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
不過，如果你以後想聽關於史雷普尼爾的故事，歡迎隨時再來找我。祝你今天愉快~

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Oh, I'm glad~
Some people would
actually be sleeping
after listening so long~
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
哦，我很高興~
有些人聽這麼長時間其實早就睡著了~

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Anyway...
The stranger turned out
to be a giant training in
stone masonry. Although he was invading Asgard, the gods didn't worry.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
總之...
那個陌生人原來是一個正在練習石工技藝的巨人。雖然他在入侵阿斯加德，但眾神並不擔心。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Thor quickly killed the giant with his mighty hammer, Mjolnir, by hurling it at the giant's head, which exploded into a thousand pieces.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
托爾迅速用他那強大的雷神之錘殺死了巨人，他將錘子擲向巨人的頭部，使其炸成了上千塊碎片。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
As for the horse, Svadilfari, it was nowhere to be found for
a long, long time.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
至於那匹馬，斯瓦迪爾法裡，在很長很長的時間裡都下落不明。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
.....
Are you bored?
If you are, let's talk
about this later.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
.....
你無聊了嗎？
如果是的話，我們可以以後再聊。

scripts.text: Let me take down some notes.
scripts.translation: 讓我記一些筆記

scripts.text: See you later.
scripts.translation: 回頭見

scripts.text: No, please go ahead.
scripts.translation: 不，請繼續

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Ah....
I see that you really want to keep track of every important detail!
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
啊...
看來你真的想記錄下每一個重要的細節！

scripts.text:
[Lania]
My apologies, I'll wait for you to complete your notes then.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
抱歉，我會等你寫完筆記的。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
May I continue the story now?
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
我可以繼續講故事了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，請

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Okay. Hmm...
Now where was I?
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
好的。嗯...
我剛才說到哪兒了？

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Oh, I guess my story wasn't really that interesting. But if you want to listen to this story again, please come visit me again.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
哦，我想我的故事可能沒那麼有趣。但如果你想再聽一遍這個故事，請再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Okay then,
travel safely~
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
那麼，旅途愉快~

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Okay. Hmm...
Now where was I?
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
好的。嗯...
我剛才說到哪兒了？

scripts.text:
[Lania]
After a while, Loki, who looked tattered and worn out, brought a strange looking pony with eight legs to Asgard.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
過了一會兒，看起來疲憊不堪的洛基帶著一匹長著八條腿的奇怪小馬來到了阿斯加德。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Loki introduced the pony as 'Sleipnir' and presented it to
Odin as a present.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
洛基將這匹馬介紹為“史雷普尼爾”，並將其作為禮物獻給了奧丁。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
In actuality, Loki transformed into the mare that seduced Svadilfari so that it would no longer work on the rampart.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
實際上，洛基變身為那匹引誘斯瓦迪爾法裡的母馬，以便它不再繼續建造城牆。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
So 'Sleipnir' was born from the legendary mare Svadilfari, and the god Loki who transformed himself into a horse.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
所以，“史雷普尼爾”是由傳奇駿馬斯瓦迪爾法裡和變身為馬的神洛基所生。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Now, stories that are spread through word of mouth might have differences in the small details, depending on who's telling the story.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
現在，口口相傳的故事可能會因為講述者的不同而在細節上有所差異。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Still, the fundamental story line should not be different.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
不過，故事的基本脈絡應該不會有所不同。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
I don't usually get to practice storytelling, and I'm not too confident of the authenticity of my version of Sleipnir's tale.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
我平時很少練習講故事，所以我不太確定我講述的史雷普尼爾的故事是否完全準確。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
But I hope you will understand that I did my best. It was the most that I could do to help you.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
但我希望你能理解，我已經盡力了。這是我為了幫助你所能做的最大努力。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
If you wish to listen to this story again, you're always welcome.
Be safe on your adventures~
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
如果你想再聽一遍這個故事，隨時歡迎。
祝你在冒險中平安~

scripts.text:
[Lania]
In times of agony, please reflect on your past to help you find a solution.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
在痛苦迷茫的時候，請回顧過去，這或許能幫你找到解決之道。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Like the old myths and legends, your experiences are stories from which you can learn valuable lessons.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
就像古老的傳說一樣，你的經歷也是故事，從中你可以學到寶貴的教訓。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
I told you everything I know. Hopefully, I was of some help to you. Please treat others with the same generosity and kindness.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
我已經告訴了你我所知道的一切。希望這對你有所幫助。請以同樣的慷慨和善意對待他人。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Training isn't limited to just physical and mental conditioning.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
訓練不僅僅侷限於身體和精神的鍛鍊。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
The way you lead your life and interact with other people can also be considered part of your training.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
你生活方式以及與他人互動的方式，也可以被視為訓練的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Everyone will learn and benefit differently, depending on how they live their day to day lives.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼婭]
每個人都會從日常生活中學到不同的東西，並從中受益，這取決於他們如何生活。
